control.note: GEFS flags its control low-resolution control (code 1), never high-resolution control (code 0): a selector written for type 0 finds no control in this ensemble.

notes.counting: 31 forecasts exist (gec00 + gep01..gep30) but every message encodes numberOfForecastsInEnsemble = 30: the octet counts perturbed members only, control excluded. The declared member set above is the sizing authority; the encoded value is verified as identity evidence and never used to size anything.
notes.namespace: geavg and gespr sit in the same directories as the members, follow the same filename pattern, and decode cleanly as ordinary fields -- the spread file reads as a plausible 0-3 K temperature. Only PDT 2/12 with a derived-forecast code separates them from a member, hence the byte-level guard.
notes.pgrb2b_statistics: pgrb2bp5 publishes exactly the 31 member names and no geavg/gespr: no ensemble-mean full column exists anywhere in this product family.
notes.split_products: pgrb2a and pgrb2b isobaric level sets are exactly disjoint (zero overlap on every variable); a sim-capable column needs both files of the SAME member.
notes.historical_layout: documented-unverified: before 2020-09-23 the bucket used a flat gefs.YYYYMMDD/HH/ layout without atmos/ and without the .0p50 token; reading the 2017-2020 archive needs a second path template that this grammar does not declare because no bytes from it were verified.
notes.live_cycle_race: a cycle in flight publishes members at different wall-clock times, so a mid-cycle listing looks like a ragged ensemble; gate acquisition on the previous complete cycle or on per-member presence of the exact step wanted.
